reason: Hypothesis A proposes a specific, testable mechanism—Si substitution reducing outward cation diffusion to promote a coherent Al2O3/Cr2O3 scale—with a clear baseline (Mn-containing alloy), controlled intervention, and a decisive falsification experiment, directly addressing the unresolved cracking/spallation issue. Hypothesis B is overly broad, merely restating known trends (Al/Si good, Mn bad) without a novel mechanistic insight or a focused comparison beyond what prior work already suggests.
